Subject: TerraHealth — short demo & proposed MAP

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. As discussed, I put together a short 30-minute demo that focuses on inference latency and cost controls for your triage pipeline. Attached is a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and our demo-deck so your procurement and infra leads can see the agenda.

Proposed demo slots next week (all ET):
- Tue 9/22 10:00–10:30
- Tue 9/22 15:00–15:30
- Wed 9/23 11:00–11:30

If those don't work, tell me a window that suits your product/infra folks and I can adjust. If procurement wants a separate walk-through, happy to join that as well.

Attachments: terrahealth_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Best,
Naomi Feldman

naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@terrahealth.com>, procurement@terrahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-22T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: TerraHealth — short demo & proposed MAP

Naomi —

Appreciate the MAP and the decks. I wanted to be upfront: we just got a Q4 roadmap update from our CTO this morning and they've pulled our experimental inference work out of the current sprint. Leadership is reallocating two engineers to a regulatory integration and we've been told to deprioritize new ML infra pilots until after the release.

Can we park the demo for now and revisit in Q1? If helpful, you can send over a recording of the demo or a one-pager with cost/latency case studies so we have something for the backlog.

I'll loop procurement if they need the MAP for budget planning, but right now it's an internal timing issue rather than vendor fit. Sorry for the late change — lots happening here.

Best,
Samir Kahn
Head of Data Platform, TerraHealth
samir.kahn@terrahealth.com

Samir — thanks for the quick note and totally understand the reprioritization.

We can absolutely park this. Two quick options to keep the deal warm without taking up your engineering bandwidth:
1) I can record a 20-min focused demo and share the recording + one-page latency/cost summary you can drop in your backlog.
2) If you want a brief 15-min sync with your product lead only (no infra deep-dive), we can do that and keep materials light.

Which would you prefer? If Q1 is the right touchpoint, what is the best follow-up month and who on your side should we include then? I'll set a stub in our pipeline for Q1 follow-up and mark the MAP as draft until your team is ready.

I'll also drop the attachments into a read-only link for procurement so they can reference the MAP without a meeting: https://drive.redwood.com/terrahealth/DH-2026-0887-MAP

Totally fine to pause — we appreciate the transparency.

Cheers,
Naomi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
